title: Edgeware & Kabocha: Project Overview [Sept 2020 - October 2022]
body:
Edgeware and Kabocha Project Overview

Below is a six page report of Edgeware and Kabocha's **105 **project requests throughout:
September 2020 - Oct 2022.

**71 **- Services
**27** - Features
**4** - Expansion
**3** - Integration


![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/bf80baef-501c-422e-9667-e053b48625a5.1667969719871)


**Project Status**

1. **Pending:** _Open Dependencies_
2. **In Progress:**  _In Development_
3. **Complete:** _Agreement Fulfilled_
4. **Unfulfilled:** _Outstanding Milestones or Deliverables_
5. **Closed:**  _Funds Returned to Treasury_


**Actionable Stages**

1. **Research: **_Scoping for Milestones and Deliverables_
2. **Implementation:** _Last Update less than 30 days_
3. **Community Update**: _Last Update greater than 60 days_
4. **Outstanding: **_Project Length > 365 days_
5. **Dynamic Service: **_New or Upgrade to an existing Citizen based Service_
6. **Dynamic Feature: **_New or Upgrade to an existing Citizen based Product_
7. **Dynamic Service Provider: **_New Contributor Support_ 
8. **Community Review:** _Subject to Moratorium_



**Improvement type for our** **DAO**

1. Marketing/Engagement
2. Community Building 
3. Technical Upgrade


**Benefit type for our Citizens**

1. Expansion
2. Integration
3. Feature
4. Service
